# Isolated GCN -> IR -> SPIR-V library. No shadPS4 core/loader/UI target.
set(FMT_DOC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FMT_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FMT_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/fmt" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/deps/fmt" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
file(GLOB_RECURSE KETSUI_SIRIT_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/sirit/src/*.cpp")
add_library(KetsuiSirit STATIC ${KETSUI_SIRIT_SOURCES})
target_compile_features(KetsuiSirit PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(KetsuiSirit PRIVATE /EHsc /W3)
target_include_directories(KetsuiSirit PUBLIC "${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/sirit/include" "${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/SPIRV-Headers/include")
target_include_directories(KetsuiSirit PRIVATE "${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/sirit/src")
file(GLOB_RECURSE KETSUI_GCN_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "src/shader_recompiler/*.cpp")
list(FILTER KETSUI_GCN_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/(flatten_extended_userdata_pass|program)\\.cpp$")
add_library(KetsuiGcn STATIC ${KETSUI_GCN_SOURCES} src/video_core/amdgpu/pixel_format.cpp host/host_program.cpp host/host_srt.cpp)
target_compile_features(KetsuiGcn PUBLIC cxx_std_23)
target_compile_options(KetsuiGcn PRIVATE /EHsc /W3)
target_compile_definitions(KetsuiGcn PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
target_include_directories(KetsuiGcn SYSTEM PUBLIC host src)
target_include_directories(KetsuiGcn SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/magic_enum/include" "${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/ext-boost")
foreach(BOOST_PART align range optional utility tuple iterator)
    target_include_directories(KetsuiGcn SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/ext-boost/libs/${BOOST_PART}/include")
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(KetsuiGcn PUBLIC fmt::fmt KetsuiSirit)
set(SPIRV_SKIP_TESTS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPIRV_SKIP_EXECUTABLES ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPIRV_TOOLS_BUILD_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPIRV_WERROR OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_SPIRV_TOOLS_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPIRV-Headers_SOURCE_DIR "${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/SPIRV-Tools-Headers")
add_subdirectory("${CAVE_PS4_DEPS}/SPIRV-Tools" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/deps/SPIRV-Tools" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
